text: Serialize phase commitment writes so concurrent creates don't drop commitments
description: Pressing Enter several times while the backend was busy fired 4 concurrent createIdeaInPhase calls. commitIdeaToPhase read the phase file, pushed its id and wrote it back without a lock, so only the last write survived. The other 3 ideas still had committedIn set but weren't in the phase's commitments, so search navigation silently did nothing for them. Fix: per-file in-process lock (withFileLock in storage/json.ts) around the phase and idea read-modify-writes in commitIdeaToPhase/removeIdeaFromPhase.

status.comment: 335a09f locked commitIdeaToPhase/removeIdeaFromPhase. c6ab941 generalizes: updatePhase/updateProjectMeta/updateIdea (storage/) do read-change-write under a per-file lock; phase create/update/reorder/delete, setCursor, commitments and idea-removal use them. Tests in packages/backend/src/commitments.test.ts: concurrent creates in a phase, commit+remove, concurrent phase creates under a parent and at the root, rename+commit (all failed before, pass after); backend 100/100, npm run check 25/25. Still in-process only; other writeProjectMeta callers (8, e.g. linked repos) and idea connect paths are not yet locked.
